text: cross session undo doesnt even work for me. again, this is the same problem as the map editor before. there was a fear of me losing cross session history but the thing was i never had it to begin with, not having it in the sense of maybe it exists, but i cant use it. all my ability to go back historically is wiped the moment i leave the page even if it isnt actually wiped. i cant access it
resolution: User ruled the decisive point: cross-session undo 'doesnt even work for me… all my ability to go back historically is wiped the moment i leave the page even if it isnt actually wiped. i cant access it' — same shape as a prior map-editor episode. This removes the only justification for the complex event-sourced model store: a feature that exists in storage but isn't wired to the UI provides zero user value while imposing the full fragility cost (the 575MB bloat + snapshot corruption that lost all 96 models). Recorded as a durable ruling in memory (feedback_dont_fear_losing_inaccessible_features): count only features the user can actually use; favor simple/isolated/robust (per-file) over event-sourcing complexity that serves an inaccessible feature; within-session in-memory undo is fine to keep. Direction set: rebuild model storage as one-file-per-model. Implementation is the next task.
